# Claude Code with Surplus Intelligence: full guide for LLMs

> Source: https://github.com/noor-latif/claude-code-glm-surplus · Web: https://noor-latif.github.io/claude-code-glm-surplus/

# Claude Code with Surplus Intelligence

Run Claude Code through [Surplus Intelligence](https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/) on Linux or Windows.

- Public Surplus base URL: `https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1`
- Claude Code protocol URL: `https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/anthropic`
- Main, Sonnet, Opus, Haiku, and subagent model: `glm-5.3`
- Vision model: `qwen3.8-omni-flash`
- Web search: free DuckDuckGo MCP server; no Surplus quota or search key required
- Separate config: `~/.claudez`

## Install on Linux or macOS

```bash
SURPLUS_API_KEY='inf_...' ./install.sh
```

The installer requires `curl`, `jq`, and Node.js for MCP tools. It stores the key at `~/.config/surplus/api_key` with user-only permissions.

To inspect or change the key interactively:

```bash
./install.sh
```

## Install on Windows

Run in PowerShell:

```powershell
$env:SURPLUS_API_KEY = 'inf_...'
.\install.ps1
```

The key is stored at `$HOME\.config\surplus\api_key` and the Windows profile is configured for PowerShell 5.1 and 7.

## Run

Open a new terminal and run:

```bash
claudez
```

The launcher blanks `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and uses `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` so Claude Code authenticates with Surplus rather than a cached Claude login.

To reinstall or update:

```bash
./install.sh --no-mcp
.\install.ps1 -NoMcp
```

To remove the launcher and MCP server:

```bash
./install.sh --uninstall --purge
.\install.ps1 -Uninstall -Purge
```

## Model configuration

| Claude role | Surplus model |
|---|---|
| Main, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku | `glm-5.3` |
| Subagent and auto mode | `glm-5.3` |
| Vision | `qwen3.8-omni-flash` |

`glm-5.3` has a 1M-token context window in the Surplus catalog; the launcher pins
`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=1000000`. The installers also merge a
`modelOverrides` entry into `~/.claudez/settings.json` so Claude Code recognizes
the Surplus model id instead of printing `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]`.

## Web search

The installer registers the `duckduckgo-search` MCP server through `npx`. It uses DuckDuckGo and does not require a separate API key.

## API endpoints

- OpenAI-compatible: `https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1`
- Claude/Anthropic Messages: `https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/anthropic`
- Model catalog: `https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1/models`

## Uninstall

The installers remove shell/profile blocks and the `duckduckgo-search` MCP entry. `--purge` / `-Purge` also deletes the stored key.

## Tests

Run the provider smoke tests against a real Surplus account:

```bash
SURPLUS_API_KEY='inf_...' python3 tests/surplus_smoke.py
```

The test validates the model catalog, GLM text routing, and Qwen vision routing using a public fixed-color PNG.

## Appendix: every script

### scripts/claudez.sh

```bash
# claudez: Claude Code through Surplus Intelligence (bash and zsh).
# Key: ~/.config/surplus/api_key (chmod 600).

unalias claudez surplus-balance 2>/dev/null

function claudez {
  local key_file="$HOME/.config/surplus/api_key"
  if [ ! -s "$key_file" ]; then
    echo "claudez: missing Surplus API key in $key_file" >&2
    echo "Get a key: https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/app/buy/quickstart" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  local key; key="$(cat "$key_file")"
  CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.claudez" \
  SURPLUS_BASE_URL="https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1" \
  ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/anthropic" \
  ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="$key" \
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="" \
  SURPLUS_API_KEY="$key" \
  API_TIMEOUT_MS=3000000 \
  ANTHROPIC_MODEL='glm-5.3' \
  ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL='glm-5.3' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL='glm-5.3' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL='glm-5.3' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL='glm-5.3' \
  CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL='glm-5.3' \
  CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=1000000 \
  CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 \
  CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL='glm-5.3' \
  CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT=1 \
  ANTHROPIC_VISION_MODEL='qwen3.8-omni-flash' \
  SURPLUS_VISION_MODEL='qwen3.8-omni-flash' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_NAME='GLM-5.3' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_NAME='GLM-5.3' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_NAME='GLM-5.3' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION='Surplus GLM-5.3, 1M context (same model as Sonnet)' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTION='Surplus GLM-5.3, 1M context' \
  ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTION='Surplus GLM-5.3, used for background tasks' \
  CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 \
    claude "$@"
}
```

### scripts/statusline.sh

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# claudez status line: model · context used
input="$(cat)"
model="$(jq -r '.model.display_name // .model.id // "GLM-5.3"' <<<"$input")"
ctx="$(jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty | floor' <<<"$input" 2>/dev/null)"
printf '%s' "$model"
[ -n "$ctx" ] && printf ' · ctx %s%%' "$ctx"
```

### scripts/claudez.ps1

```powershell
# claudez: Claude Code through Surplus Intelligence (PowerShell 5.1 and 7).
# Key: ~/.config/surplus/api_key (owner-only ACL).

function claudez {
  $keyFile = Join-Path $HOME '.config\surplus\api_key'
  if (-not (Test-Path $keyFile) -or -not "$(Get-Content $keyFile -Raw)".Trim()) {
    Write-Host "Get a key: https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/app/buy/quickstart"
    Write-Error "claudez: missing Surplus API key in $keyFile"; return
  }
  $key = (Get-Content $keyFile -Raw).Trim()
  $vars = @{
    CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR                        = Join-Path $HOME '.claudez'
    SURPLUS_BASE_URL                         = 'https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1'
    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL                       = 'https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/anthropic'
    ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN                     = $key
    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY                        = ''
    SURPLUS_API_KEY                          = $key
    API_TIMEOUT_MS                           = '3000000'
    ANTHROPIC_MODEL                          = 'glm-5.3'
    ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL               = 'glm-5.3'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL             = 'glm-5.3'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL           = 'glm-5.3'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL            = 'glm-5.3'
    CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL               = 'glm-5.3'
    CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW          = '1000000'
    CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER             = '0'
    CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL              = 'glm-5.3'
    CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT         = '1'
    ANTHROPIC_VISION_MODEL                   = 'qwen3.8-omni-flash'
    SURPLUS_VISION_MODEL                     = 'qwen3.8-omni-flash'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_NAME        = 'GLM-5.3'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_NAME      = 'GLM-5.3'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_NAME       = 'GLM-5.3'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION   = 'Surplus GLM-5.3, 1M context (same model as Sonnet)'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTION = 'Surplus GLM-5.3, 1M context'
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTION  = 'Surplus GLM-5.3, used for background tasks'
    CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
  }
  $saved = @{}
  foreach ($name in $vars.Keys) {
    $saved[$name] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, 'Process')
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $vars[$name], 'Process')
  }
  try { claude @args }
  finally {
    foreach ($name in $saved.Keys) {
      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $saved[$name], 'Process')
    }
  }
}
```

### scripts/statusline.ps1

```powershell
# claudez status line (Windows): model | context used
try { $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $in = $null }
$parts = @(@($in.model.display_name, $in.model.id) | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1)
if (-not $parts) { $parts = @('GLM-5.3') }
if ($null -ne $in.context_window.used_percentage) {
  $parts += "ctx $([math]::Floor($in.context_window.used_percentage))%"
}
$parts -join ' | '
```

### config/settings.json

```json
{
  "permissions": {
    "deny": [
      "Read(~/.config/surplus/**)"
    ]
  },
  "statusLine": {
    "type": "command",
    "command": "~/.claudez/statusline.sh",
    "padding": 0
  },
  "modelOverrides": {
    "claude-sonnet-4-6": "glm-5.3"
  }
}
```

### install.sh

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# claudez installer for Linux and macOS.
# Sets up `claudez` with Surplus model routing and DuckDuckGo web search.
#
#   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/noor-latif/claude-code-glm-surplus/v1.3.0/install.sh | bash
#   ./install.sh [--no-mcp] [--ref TAG] | --uninstall [--purge]
#
# Non-interactive: SURPLUS_API_KEY=... ./install.sh
# https://github.com/noor-latif/claude-code-glm-surplus
set -euo pipefail

REPO="noor-latif/claude-code-glm-surplus"
REF="v1.3.0"
PLAN_URL="https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/app/buy/quickstart"
DEST="$HOME/.claudez"
KEY_FILE="$HOME/.config/surplus/api_key"
MARK_BEGIN="# >>> claudez >>>"
MARK_END="# <<< claudez <<<"
FILES="scripts/claudez.sh scripts/statusline.sh config/settings.json"
MCP_NAMES="duckduckgo-search"

action=do_install; purge=0; with_mcp=1
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --uninstall) action=do_uninstall ;;
    --purge) purge=1 ;;
    --no-mcp) with_mcp=0 ;;
    --ref) REF="$2"; shift ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,10p' "$0" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "Unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
  shift
done

say()  { printf '\033[1m==>\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\033[33mwarning:\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { printf '\033[31merror:\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

# rc files to manage: existing ~/.bashrc and ~/.zshrc, plus the one for the login shell
rc_files() {
  local shell_name; shell_name="$(basename "${SHELL:-bash}")"
  local list=""
  [ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ] && list="$list $HOME/.bashrc"
  [ -f "$HOME/.zshrc" ] && list="$list $HOME/.zshrc"
  case "$shell_name" in
    zsh) case "$list" in *"$HOME/.zshrc"*) ;; *) list="$list $HOME/.zshrc" ;; esac ;;
    bash)
      if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then
        list="$list $HOME/.bash_profile"   # macOS Terminal starts login shells
      else
        case "$list" in *"$HOME/.bashrc"*) ;; *) list="$list $HOME/.bashrc" ;; esac
      fi ;;
  esac
  echo "$list"
}

strip_block() {  # remove our marked block from file $1, in place
  [ -f "$1" ] || return 0
  grep -qF "$MARK_BEGIN" "$1" || return 0
  local tmp; tmp="$(mktemp)"
  awk -v b="$MARK_BEGIN" -v e="$MARK_END" '$0==b{skip=1;next} $0==e{skip=0;next} !skip' "$1" > "$tmp"
  cat "$tmp" > "$1"; rm -f "$tmp"
}

claudez_mcp() { CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$DEST" claude "$@"; }

mcp_exists() {
  [ -f "$DEST/.claude.json" ] && jq -e --arg n "$1" '.mcpServers[$n] != null' "$DEST/.claude.json" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

do_uninstall() {
  say "Removing claudez"
  for rc in $HOME/.bashrc $HOME/.zshrc $HOME/.bash_profile; do
    if [ -f "$rc" ] && grep -qF "$MARK_BEGIN" "$rc"; then strip_block "$rc"; say "Cleaned $rc"; fi
  done
  if command -v claude >/dev/null; then
    for n in $MCP_NAMES; do mcp_exists "$n" && claudez_mcp mcp remove -s user "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1 && say "Removed MCP server $n"; done
  fi
  if [ -f "$DEST/settings.json" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null; then
    local tmp; tmp="$(mktemp)"
    jq '
      (if (.statusLine.command // "") | test("claudez/statusline") then del(.statusLine) else . end)
      |       (if .permissions.deny then .permissions.deny -= ["Read(~/.config/surplus/**)"] else . end)
    ' "$DEST/settings.json" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$DEST/settings.json"
    say "Cleaned $DEST/settings.json"
  fi
  rm -f "$DEST/claudez.sh" "$DEST/statusline.sh"
  if [ "$purge" = 1 ]; then rm -f "$KEY_FILE"; say "Deleted $KEY_FILE"; else say "Kept your key in $KEY_FILE (use --purge to delete it)"; fi
  say "Done. $DEST is kept because it holds your Claude Code history and settings."
}

do_install() {
  command -v curl >/dev/null || die "curl is required"
  command -v jq >/dev/null || die "jq is required. Install it first (Fedora: sudo dnf install jq, Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install jq, macOS: brew install jq)"
  command -v claude >/dev/null || warn "Claude Code not found. Install it: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash"

  # 1. key
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$KEY_FILE")"
  if [ -n "${SURPLUS_API_KEY:-}" ]; then
    (umask 077; printf '%s' "$SURPLUS_API_KEY" > "$KEY_FILE")
    say "Saved key from SURPLUS_API_KEY to $KEY_FILE"
  elif [ -s "$KEY_FILE" ]; then
    say "Using existing key in $KEY_FILE"
  else
    [ -r /dev/tty ] || die "No terminal to ask for the key. Run with SURPLUS_API_KEY=... set."
    printf 'Get a Surplus API key here:\n  %s\n' "$PLAN_URL" > /dev/tty
    printf 'Paste your Surplus API key (input hidden): ' > /dev/tty
    local key; IFS= read -rs key < /dev/tty; echo > /dev/tty
    key="$(printf '%s' "$key" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
    [ -n "$key" ] || die "No key entered. Get a Surplus API key at $PLAN_URL"
    (umask 077; printf '%s' "$key" > "$KEY_FILE")
    say "Saved key to $KEY_FILE"
  fi
  chmod 600 "$KEY_FILE"

  # 2. files: from this clone if we are in one, else from GitHub at $REF
  local src="" here
  # shellcheck disable=SC2015
  here="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}")" 2>/dev/null && pwd || true)"
  [ -n "$here" ] && [ -f "$here/scripts/claudez.sh" ] && src="$here"
  stage="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
  for f in $FILES; do
    mkdir -p "$stage/$(dirname "$f")"
    if [ -n "$src" ]; then cp "$src/$f" "$stage/$f"
    else curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$REPO/$REF/$f" -o "$stage/$f" || die "Download failed: $f"
    fi
  done
  say "Installing scripts from ${src:-github.com/$REPO@$REF} into $DEST"
  mkdir -p "$DEST"
  install -m 755 "$stage/scripts/statusline.sh" "$DEST/"
  install -m 755 "$stage/scripts/claudez.sh" "$DEST/"

  # 3. settings: merge, keeping whatever is already there
  local settings="$DEST/settings.json" tmp; tmp="$(mktemp)"
  [ -s "$settings" ] || echo '{}' > "$settings"
  cp "$settings" "$settings.bak.claudez"
  jq --slurpfile t "$stage/config/settings.json" '
    $t[0] as $t
    | .permissions.deny = (((.permissions.deny // []) + $t.permissions.deny) | unique)
    | (if (.statusLine == null) or ((.statusLine.command // "") | test("claudez/statusline"))
       then .statusLine = $t.statusLine else . end)
    | .modelOverrides = (($t.modelOverrides // {}) + (.modelOverrides // {}))
  ' "$settings" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$settings"
  if ! jq -e '(.statusLine.command // "") | test("claudez/statusline")' "$settings" >/dev/null; then
    warn "Kept your existing statusLine in $settings; the Surplus status line was not enabled"
  fi
  say "Merged settings into $settings (backup: $settings.bak.claudez)"

  # 4. shell rc block
  for rc in $(rc_files); do
    [ -f "$rc" ] && cp "$rc" "$rc.bak.claudez"
    strip_block "$rc"
    # start on a fresh line, or the marker gets glued to the file's last line
    if [ -s "$rc" ] && [ -n "$(tail -c1 "$rc")" ]; then echo >> "$rc"; fi
    {
      echo "$MARK_BEGIN"
      echo '# claudez: Claude Code through Surplus Intelligence.'
      # shellcheck disable=SC2016
      echo '[ -f "$HOME/.claudez/claudez.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.claudez/claudez.sh"'
      echo "$MARK_END"
    } >> "$rc"
    say "Added claudez to $rc"
  done

  # 5. Free DuckDuckGo web search MCP; no third-party API key required.
  if [ "$with_mcp" = 1 ] && command -v claude >/dev/null; then
    mcp_exists duckduckgo-search || claudez_mcp mcp add -s user duckduckgo-search \
      -- npx -y duckduckgo-websearch >/dev/null
    say "MCP servers ready: $MCP_NAMES"
  fi

  # 6. checks
  if command -v node >/dev/null; then
    local major; major="$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    [ "$major" -ge 22 ] || warn "Node.js $major found; Claude Code MCP tools need Node.js 22 or newer"
  else
    warn "Node.js not found; the DuckDuckGo web search MCP needs Node.js"
  fi
  echo
  say "Installed. Open a new terminal (or source your shell rc), then run: claudez"
}

"$action"
```

### install.ps1

```powershell
# ClaudeZ installer for Windows PowerShell 5.1 and 7.
# Non-interactive: $env:SURPLUS_API_KEY = '...'; .\install.ps1
param(
  [switch]$Uninstall,
  [switch]$Purge,
  [switch]$NoMcp
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12

$Repo = 'noor-latif/claude-code-glm-surplus'
$Ref = 'v1.3.0'
$PlanUrl = 'https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/app/buy/quickstart'
$Dest = Join-Path $HOME '.claudez'
$KeyFile = Join-Path $HOME '.config/surplus/api_key'
$MarkBegin = '# >>> claudez >>>'
$MarkEnd = '# <<< claudez <<<'
$DenyRule = 'Read(~/.config/surplus/**)'
$OnWindows = ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -eq 'Desktop') -or $IsWindows
$PsExe = if ($OnWindows) { 'powershell' } else { 'pwsh' }

function Say($m) { Write-Host "==> $m" }
function Warn($m) { Write-Warning $m }
function Fwd($p) { $p -replace '\\', '/' }

function Get-ProfilePaths {
  if ($OnWindows) {
    $docs = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyDocuments')
    @((Join-Path $docs 'WindowsPowerShell/profile.ps1'), (Join-Path $docs 'PowerShell/profile.ps1'))
  } else {
    @($PROFILE.CurrentUserAllHosts)
  }
}

function Remove-Block($path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $path)) { return }
  $lines = @(Get-Content $path)
  if ($lines -notcontains $MarkBegin) { return }
  $out = @()
  $skip = $false
  foreach ($line in $lines) {
    if ($line -eq $MarkBegin) { $skip = $true; continue }
    if ($line -eq $MarkEnd) { $skip = $false; continue }
    if (-not $skip) { $out += $line }
  }
  Set-Content -Path $path -Value $out
}

function Read-Settings {
  $file = Join-Path $Dest 'settings.json'
  if ((Test-Path $file) -and "$(Get-Content $file -Raw)".Trim()) {
    return Get-Content $file -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  }
  return [pscustomobject]@{}
}

function Set-Prop($obj, $name, $value) {
  if ($obj.PSObject.Properties[$name]) { $obj.$name = $value }
  else { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $name -NotePropertyValue $value }
}

function Write-Settings($obj) {
  $json = $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $Dest 'settings.json'), $json, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
}

function Invoke-Uninstall {
  Say 'Removing claudez'
  foreach ($profile in Get-ProfilePaths) { Remove-Block $profile }
  if (Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    $env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR = $Dest
    claude mcp remove -s user duckduckgo-search 2>$null
  }
  $settingsFile = Join-Path $Dest 'settings.json'
  if (Test-Path $settingsFile) {
    $settings = Read-Settings
    if ($settings.statusLine -and "$($settings.statusLine.command)" -match 'claudez[/\\]statusline') {
      $settings.PSObject.Properties.Remove('statusLine')
    }
    if ($settings.permissions -and $settings.permissions.deny) {
      $settings.permissions.deny = @($settings.permissions.deny | Where-Object { $_ -ne $DenyRule })
    }
    Write-Settings $settings
  }
  Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $Dest 'claudez.ps1')
  Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $Dest 'statusline.ps1')
  if ($Purge) { Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $KeyFile; Say "Deleted $KeyFile" }
  else { Say "Kept your key in $KeyFile (use -Purge to delete it)" }
  Say "Done. $Dest is kept because it holds your Claude Code history and settings."
}

function Invoke-Install {
  if (-not (Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    Warn 'Claude Code not found. Install it first: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup'
  }

  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $KeyFile) | Out-Null
  if ($env:SURPLUS_API_KEY) {
    Set-Content -Path $KeyFile -Value $env:SURPLUS_API_KEY.Trim() -NoNewline
    Say 'Saved key from SURPLUS_API_KEY'
  } elseif ((Test-Path $KeyFile) -and "$(Get-Content $KeyFile -Raw)".Trim()) {
    Say "Using existing key in $KeyFile"
  } else {
    Write-Host "Get a Surplus API key: $PlanUrl"
    $secure = Read-Host 'Paste your Surplus API key (input hidden)' -AsSecureString
    $bstr = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($secure)
    try { $key = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($bstr) }
    finally { [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($bstr) }
    $key = ($key -replace '\s', '')
    if (-not $key) { throw "No key entered. Get a Surplus API key at $PlanUrl" }
    Set-Content -Path $KeyFile -Value $key -NoNewline
  }
  if ($OnWindows) { icacls $KeyFile /inheritance:r /grant:r "$($env:USERNAME):F" | Out-Null }
  else { chmod 600 $KeyFile }

  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Dest | Out-Null
  $src = if ($PSScriptRoot -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'scripts/claudez.ps1'))) { $PSScriptRoot } else { $null }
  foreach ($file in 'scripts/claudez.ps1', 'scripts/statusline.ps1') {
    $dst = Join-Path $Dest (Split-Path $file -Leaf)
    if ($src) { Copy-Item -Force (Join-Path $src $file) $dst }
    else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$Repo/$Ref/$file" -OutFile $dst }
    if ($OnWindows) { Unblock-File $dst }
  }

  $settingsFile = Join-Path $Dest 'settings.json'
  if (Test-Path $settingsFile) { Copy-Item -Force $settingsFile "$settingsFile.bak.claudez" }
  $settings = Read-Settings
  if (-not $settings.permissions) { Set-Prop $settings 'permissions' ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
  Set-Prop $settings.permissions 'deny' (@(@($settings.permissions.deny) + $DenyRule | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -Unique))
  $statusCmd = "$PsExe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $(Fwd (Join-Path $Dest 'statusline.ps1'))"
  if (-not $settings.statusLine -or "$($settings.statusLine.command)" -match 'claudez[/\\]statusline') {
    Set-Prop $settings 'statusLine' ([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'command'; command = $statusCmd; padding = 0 })
  }
  if (-not $settings.modelOverrides) { Set-Prop $settings 'modelOverrides' ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
  $settings.modelOverrides | Add-Member -Force -NotePropertyName 'claude-sonnet-4-6' -NotePropertyValue 'glm-5.3'
  Write-Settings $settings

  foreach ($profile in Get-ProfilePaths) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $profile) | Out-Null
    if (Test-Path $profile) { Copy-Item -Force $profile "$profile.bak.claudez"; Remove-Block $profile | Out-Null }
    Add-Content -Path $profile -Value @(
      $MarkBegin,
      '# Claude Code through Surplus Intelligence',
      '$czScript = Join-Path $HOME ''.claudez/claudez.ps1''; if (Test-Path $czScript) { . $czScript }; Remove-Variable czScript',
      $MarkEnd
    )
  }

  if (-not $NoMcp -and (Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    $env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR = $Dest
    claude mcp add -s user duckduckgo-search -- npx -y duckduckgo-websearch 2>$null
    Say 'MCP server ready: DuckDuckGo web search'
  }
  Say 'Installed. Open a new PowerShell window, then run: claudez'
}

if ($Uninstall) { Invoke-Uninstall } else { Invoke-Install }
```
